title: Plan tiers are no longer auto-expanded by default
summary: The tiers property on Plan is no longer included by default.

migrationNotes.text: Lets you optimize performance by not automatically including the tiers property on the Plan object. You can still list the tiers, but Stripe recommends against it for performance reasons.

sources.quote: | [Plan tiers are no longer auto-expanded by default](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2020-08-27/deprecates-auto-expansion-plan-tiers.md) | Billing | Breaking | api |
The `tiers` property on `Plan` is no longer included by default.
